crossRefs.note: “ ‘This is the law of jealousy, when a wife, being under her husband, goes astray, and is defiled,
or when the spirit of jealousy comes on a man, and he is jealous of his wife; then he shall set the woman before…
“ ‘This is the law of the animal, and of the bird, and of every living creature that moves in the waters, and of every…
to make a distinction between the unclean and the clean, and between the living thing that may be eaten and the living…
This is the law of the plague of mildew in a garment of wool or linen, either in the warp, or the woof, or in anything…
This is the law for any plague of leprosy, and for an itch,
This is the law of him who has a discharge, and of him who has an emission of semen, so that he is unclean by it;
and of her who has her period, and of a man or woman who has a discharge, and of him who lies with her who is unclean.

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: These are the statutes which Yahweh commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, being in her youth, in her father’s house.
translations.bsb: These are the statutes that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the relationship between a man and his wife, and between a father and a young daughter still in his home.
translations.kjv: These are the statutes, which the LORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between the father and his daughter, being yet in her youth in her father's house.
translations.asv: These are the statutes, which Jehovah commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, being in her youth, in her father's house.
